aboutBody: Explore three map-checked Kyoto walks with optional GPS or simulated movement. Progress is saved only in this browser. Routes await field review, step-free access is unverified, crowd levels and bonus scenarios are demo samples, and all points, shops and vouchers are fictional and not redeemable.
bonusBusScenario: Demo scenario: buses along Shijō-dōri are assumed to be crowded right now. This is not real bus data.
bonusQuietScenario: Demo scenario: Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park are assumed to be outside their busy hours right now. This is not real crowd data.
missionsBonusBody: Kyoto Flow keeps two incentives apart: a bus-relief bonus for walking instead of taking a crowded bus, and a quiet-hour bonus for visiting a place outside its busy hours. Neither uses real data yet. A presenter can switch on one hypothetical scenario in Me.
missionsBonusNone: No bonus scenario is on. Check-ins earn the standard rate.
missionsVerifyNote: Check-ins confirm a visit near each stop, not how you travelled.
scenarioHint: Hypothetical scenarios for demonstrations. They never use real bus or crowd data.

helpIntro: Kyoto Flow is a prototype. Here is what each part can and can't tell you.
helpCheckinsBody: A GPS check-in shows you were near a stop. It can't tell how you travelled or prove you avoided a bus. Demo Mode check-ins are simulated.
helpHaloBody: The translucent 60 m circle around the fox is a visual proximity cue that scales with map zoom. Live GPS check-in uses a separate 75 m distance and ±50 m accuracy requirement.
helpScenariosBody: Bus-relief and quiet-hour bonuses are hypothetical demo scenarios a presenter switches on. They don't use real bus or crowd data.
helpVouchersBody: Points have no cash value. Every voucher is fictional and marked DEMO — NOT REDEEMABLE; no shop accepts them.
helpCrowdBody: Crowd badges are demo samples with no source or time. Places without a sample show Unknown, never Calm.

privacyBody: Location is only read in the foreground while Explore is open and is never sent to a server or stored as history. Profile, progress, and saved items stay on this browser.

safetyBody: Official external disaster guidance for Kyoto. Nearest-shelter status is not shown because this prototype has no live shelter feed.
reportIssueBody: In a field pilot, reports go to the Kyoto Flow route-review team to check and suspend affected corridors. This prototype saves nothing online.
